methods.title: Group and aggregate
methods.description: Group all accepted rows by date. Filter matching groups locally.
methods.formula: Sum / average of valid numeric values, or row count, per group.
methods.missing: Blank groups appear as (missing). Blank numeric values are excluded from numeric aggregation and counted in exclusions.
methods.assumptions: No deduplication. Dates remain source calendar dates. Search is case-insensitive. Imported types and delimiter are user-confirmed.
